question: Which metro and category pairs have the highest white-space opportunity?
text:
The top white-space target is **Houston in Food & Beverage Stores**. It has the highest opportunity score (9.52), only 8.0% penetration and $5.5B in white-space volume.



- **Food & Beverage Stores makes up 8 of the top 10.** This category has the fastest demand growth in the list (10.35%), so it scores well in almost every metro.
- **Phoenix in Restaurants & Food Service is #2 (8.65).** It has the lowest penetration in the top 10 (6.0%) and $2.9B in white-space volume.
- **New York-Newark in Food & Beverage Stores has by far the most white-space volume at $17.5B.** It ranks only #7 on opportunity score because its penetration is already higher, at 23.4%. If total untapped dollars matter more than the gap ratio, it's the largest prize.
- **Philadelphia shows up twice:** Food & Beverage Stores (8.37, $3.4B) and Restaurants & Food Service (7.81, $2.4B). That makes it a strong market to enter both categories at once.

tables.title: Top 10 Metro x Category Pairs by Opportunity Score

sql:
WITH __ss AS (
  SELECT
    category_name,
    metro_name,
    category_demand_growth_pct,
    opportunity_score,
    penetration_pct,
    white_space_volume
  FROM SNOWPACK_SITE_SELECTION.CORE.SITE_SELECTION_BENCHMARK
)
SELECT
  metro_name,
  category_name,
  opportunity_score,
  white_space_volume,
  penetration_pct,
  category_demand_growth_pct
FROM __ss
ORDER BY
  opportunity_score DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10 /* Generated by Cortex */;
